title: Assistant agentic orchestrator integration (flag-off)
intent: Wire the previously decoupled assistant agentic components into the production orchestrator and app DI seam while leaving the default legacy plan/approve path dark behind assistant.agentic.enabled=false.
scope: Route HandlePromptRequest through AssistantAgentLoop.StartTurn only when assistant.agentic.enabled is true; preserve the legacy single-shot planner path when false.
Accept assistant approval requests keyed by action_id as well as legacy plan_hash, and resume deferred actions through AssistantAgentLoop.ResumeAfterActionDecision.
Register startup waiting_async recovery against AssistantAgentLoop.ResumeAfterAsyncObservation so recovered terminal observations advance the next model iteration.

In internal/app/app.go, construct the OpenAI-compatible agent model client, assistant tool runtime, permission engine, transcript store, MCP registry/runtime/schema adapters, and loop behind the feature flag.
Keep frontend enablement and action-level UI out of scope for item 9.
out_of_scope: Frontend rendering or publishing changes for action_id approvals.
Subagents, skills, hooks, commands, external MCP servers, or Anthropic runtime selection.
Changing Nostr event kinds or payload schemas beyond already-added action_id fields and status content metadata.
architecture_notes: internal/app/app.go is the intentional seam where internal/mcp descriptors and results are adapted into internal/service-local interfaces, avoiding an internal/service -> internal/mcp import cycle.
The orchestrator owns the rollout flag. AgenticEnabled=false keeps existing plan_hash planning, approval, async observation, and duplicate-submission behavior unchanged.
The transcript key provider derives a service-held XChaCha20 key from the already-required service Nostr private key for deterministic restart/replay behavior without hardcoded key material.
Startup recovery no longer stops at AssistantToolRuntime.ResumeAsync; it calls the loop API so a recovered async observation can be appended and fed to the next model step.
